title: woof!
body:
# woof!
**woof!** or Wesker's Obnoxiously Optimized Fabric/NeoForge is an out of the ordinary Minecraft optimization modpack with the primary focus of **truly** optimizing minecraft and make it as speedy as possible with the help of Mods!

> ⚠️ **DISCLAIMER**\
> **The NeoForge versions of this modpack is experimental!** While they exist, they don't really have the proper mods in order to have the same performance gain from what you can get from the original Fabric version of this modpack.

## woof?
**This is not just gonna be *another optimization modpack*!** ..While the primary focus of this modpack is Optimizations, this does a lot more than what most optimization modpack offers!

**woof!** attempts to optimize minecraft in many different ways, With some of them being the usual.. making minecraft run faster to get huge FPS gains, faster worldgen, better rendering, etc. (you know what I mean) And some being out of the ordinary, like faster resource pack loading, faster loading, subtle (and maybe unnoticable) fixes and patches, and many more!

## woof!!
While minecraft optimization modpacks like these do make minecraft run a lot faster, **it isn't enough to truly make it run at it's fullest potential!** And because of that, I am recommending you (if you have some time) to read my Guide for Minecraft Optimization (for the client!)

The guide helps with very low-tier to mid-tier computers! And it has been helping me make minecraft run a lot better!

[You can check out the guide here!](https://github.com/weskified/weskers-minecraft-optimization/blob/main/README.md#client-optimizations)

## Versioning Format
The versioning format for this modpack is `<mcversion>-<modloader>+X.Y(.Z)(-modifier)`
- `mcversion` is the minecraft version that the modpack runs on.
- `modloader` is the minecraft modloader that the modpack runs on.
- `X` is a modlist revision (added/removed mods)
- `Y` is a config revision (changes, tweaks, or additions)
- `Z` is for small changes (mod updates, config fixes, etc.)
- `modifier` is a display to identify if a modpack is in `alpha` or `beta` release.

The version of the modpack restarts to 1.0 for each version of minecraft.

</details>
